verdict.rationale: Khoj's docs explicitly document a telemetry opt-out mechanism via the KHOJ_TELEMETRY_DISABLE environment variable, giving users a clear, documented way to disable tracking, and align with the broader privacy stance of self-hosting to keep data local. Missing for 10: independent verification that the opt-out actually stops all telemetry calls, and clarification addressing an older community complaint about unclear telemetry practices (khoj-comm-9), which is not concrete proof of failure but does reduce certainty.
